method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the party to a civil proceeding, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where the text says no, a NOTHING-kind answer where it does not answer); dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (s 6(5)(b), PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... HENCE FULFILLED LEST BREACH BY ... BECAUSE) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Jurisdiction of Courts (Cross-vesting) Act 1987 (Tas), No. 78 of 1987, consolidated version published 2025-09-22 and current on Tasmanian Legislation Online on 6 November 2026, retrieved 2026-11-06T12:09:43Z, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1987-078.txt. No regulations set a number the Act uses.

seat: the party to a civil proceeding (usually the person bringing the claim; the party answering it asks the same questions with the same answers) whose proceeding meets the cross-vesting scheme (tasjcxv-claims.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tasjcxv-dates.l4 ; l4 run tasjcxv-claims.l4 ; l4 run tasjcxv-cases.l4
checks.result: 140 assertions written, 140 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file; 2 #TRACEs (1 fulfilled, 1 breached) as their expect lines say (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch file showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: The whole operative Act. In: s 3(1), (2); s 3A; s 4(3)-(5); s 5(1)-(4), (6)-(9); s 6(1)-(9); s 6A(1)-(7); s 7(1)-(7); s 8(1)-(3); s 9 (folded into ss 4 and 5); s 10; s 11(1), (3); s 12; s 13; s 14(2), (3). Out: the preamble, ss 1, 2 (machinery); s 15 (reading down); s 16 (suspension by proclamation); s 17 (transitional); the omitted provisions. Reasons in NOTES.md.
